surface: Renaming a column header with the keyboard: F2 on a focused header opens a named field holding the name, Enter saves it and announces the new name, and Escape cancels.

steps.note: Navigable headers let ArrowUp enter the Price column header. VoiceOver with WebKit says nothing on this first arrow key, as on the first key of other scenarios.
F2 opens the field over the header, named `Header name`, holding the name selected. Finding: VoiceOver with WebKit says nothing when the field takes the focus.
Typing replaces the selected name. Nothing is required: a reader may echo the keys.
Enter saves the name, closes the field and puts the focus back on the header, now `Cost`; the plugin announces `Header renamed to Cost` (polite).
The field opens again, holding the new name.
Escape closes the field without saving, and the focus is back on the header, still `Cost`.
